title: Voting
needs_owner_check: Player text disagrees with the config in two places: site faq.json says every site is every 24 hours and a vote party fires every twenty votes, and ChromaticHelp answers.yml says each vote gives money. VotingPlugin at mc-server 63529705 has minecraftservers.org every 8 hours, a 60-vote party and no money per vote; this page follows the config. 'Miss one day in seven' reads AllowMissedAmount 1 / AllowMissedPeriod 7.
summary: **Voting** for Chromabit on server lists earns a Vote Key and 2 minutes of Vote Fly for every vote.

blocks.p: Bonus keys come from voting on every site, keeping a streak and topping the monthly list.
Type `/vote` in game for the list of sites with clickable links. The five sites and how often each one lets you vote:

ul: {{icon:tripwire_hook}} **Every vote**: 1 Vote Key and 2 minutes of [Vote Fly](/wiki/smp/vote-fly/).
{{icon:tripwire_hook}} **All 5 sites in one day**: a bonus Vote Key.
{{icon:tripwire_hook}} **Vote party**: when the server reaches 60 votes in a day, everyone online gets a Vote Key. The count starts over each day.
{{icon:tripwire_hook}} **Streaks**: vote at least once a day. Day 3 gives a bonus Vote Key, day 7 a Shard Key and day 14 a Chroma Key. You can miss one day in seven without losing the streak.
{{icon:tripwire_hook}} **Top voters**: at the end of each month, 1st place gets 2 Chroma Keys, 2nd a Chroma Key and 3rd a Shard Key.

blocks.p: Vote Keys open the Vote Crate at spawn, which also has its own milestones. See [Crates and Keys](/wiki/smp/crates/).

ul: MinecraftServers.org lets you vote three times a day, so it alone is worth 3 Vote Keys and 6 minutes of fly.
Vote Fly only works in claims you own or are trusted to build in.
Some Battle Pass quests count votes too.
